newsitem.title: SPAIN: BASKETBALL-FETISSOV MAY PAY FOR BARCELONA'S PROBLEMS.
newsitem.headline: BASKETBALL-FETISSOV MAY PAY FOR BARCELONA'S PROBLEMS.

text.p: Barcelona are set to release Russian forward Andrei Fetissov after the latest setback in their worst basketball season for years.
Fetissov made two crucial mistakes in the 71-70 defeat by Smelt Olipija of Slovenia on Wednesday, which left Barcelona fourth in European championship group C.
It was the fourth successive European defeat for a team who almost beat Panathinaikos in last season's final.
Fetissov also bore the brunt of coach Aito Garcia's criticism after Saturday's humilliating 81-67 Spanish league defeat at Xacobeo Orense, the first time Barcelona had ever lost to the Galician side.
"I've lost confidence in Fetissov, he's incapable of concentrating," said Garcia.
Barcelona have an option to end Fetissov's contract at the end of the November.
Garcia also pointed to the lack of form of several other key players.

Puerto Rican centre Ramon Rivas has failed to reproduce the play that made him a major figure last season at Taugres. Influential Lithuanian forward Arturas Karnishovas is showing signs of fatigue after playing in the Atlanta Olympics.
